# Ezekiel 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-spirit lifted-me and-brought-me to the-gate-of the-house-of YHWH, the-eastern, the-one-facing eastward; and-behold, at-the-entrance-of the-gate, twenty-five men; and-I-saw in-their-midst Jaazaniah son-of Azzur and-Pelatiah son-of Benaiah, princes-of the-people.

**2** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, these [are] the-men who-devise iniquity and-who-counsel counsel evil in-this city,

**3** who-say, 'It-is-not near — to-build houses; she [is] the-pot, and-we [are] the-meat.'

**4** Therefore prophesy against-them; prophesy, son-of man."

**5** And-the-spirit-of YHWH fell upon-me, and-He-said to-me, "Say, 'Thus says YHWH: So you-have-said, house-of Israel; and-the-risings-of your-spirit — I know-them.

**6** You-have-multiplied your-slain in-this city, and-you-have-filled her-streets [with]-the-slain.'

**7** Therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Your-slain whom you-have-placed in-her-midst — they [are] the-meat, and-she [is] the-pot; but-you I-will-bring-out from-her-midst.

**8** A-sword you-have-feared, and-a-sword I-will-bring upon-you,' declares the-Lord YHWH.

**9** 'And-I-will-bring-you-out from-her-midst, and-I-will-give-you into-the-hand-of strangers, and-I-will-execute judgments against-you.

**10** By-the-sword you-shall-fall; at the-border-of Israel I-will-judge-you, and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH.

**11** She shall-not-be to-you for-a-pot, and-you shall-not-be in-her-midst for-meat; at the-border-of Israel I-will-judge-you,

**12** and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH, whose statutes you-did-not-walk-in and-whose-judgments you-did-not-do, but-according-to the-judgments-of the-nations which [are] around-you, you-have-done.'"

**13** And-it-was as-I-prophesied — and-Pelatiah son-of Benaiah died; and-I-fell upon my-face and-cried [with a]-voice great and-said, "Ah, Lord YHWH! A-complete-end are-You making of-the-remnant-of Israel?"

**14** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**15** "Son-of man, your-brothers, your-brothers, the-men-of your-redemption and-all the-house-of Israel — all-of-them — to-whom the-inhabitants-of Jerusalem said, 'Be-far from-upon YHWH; to-us she-has-been-given, the-land, for-a-possession.'

**16** Therefore say, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Though I-removed-them-far among-the-nations, and-though I-scattered-them among-the-lands, yet-I-have-been to-them a-sanctuary [for]-a-little-while in-the-lands where they-have-gone.'

**17** Therefore say, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: And-I-will-gather-you from-the-peoples, and-I-will-assemble-you from-the-lands where you-have-been-scattered, and-I-will-give to-you the-land-of Israel.'

**18** And-they-shall-come there, and-they-shall-remove all her-detestable-things and-all her-abominations from-her.

**19** And-I-will-give-them a-heart one, and-a-spirit new I-will-put within-them; and-I-will-remove the-heart-of stone from-their-flesh, and-I-will-give-them a-heart-of flesh,

**20** so-that in-My-statutes they-walk and-My-judgments they-keep and-do-them; and-they-shall-be to-Me for-a-people, and-I will-be to-them for-God.

**21** But-[those whose]-heart walks-after the-heart-of their-detestable-things and-their-abominations — their-way upon-their-head I-will-put," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**22** And-the-cherubim lifted their-wings, and-the-wheels beside-them, and-the-glory-of the-God-of Israel [was] over-them from-above.

**23** And-the-glory-of YHWH went-up from-upon the-midst-of the-city, and-stood upon the-mountain which [is] to-the-east-of the-city.

**24** And-the-spirit lifted-me and-brought-me to-Chaldea, to the-exiles, in-the-vision, in-the-spirit-of God; and-the-vision which I-saw went-up from-upon-me.

**25** And-I-spoke to the-exiles all the-things-of YHWH which He-showed-me.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **11:19**: Lev echad... ruach chadashah — 'a heart one... a spirit new.' The new-heart promise anticipates 36:26-27. The stone/flesh contrast captures the transformation from spiritual deadness to living responsiveness.

- **11:16**: Miqdash me'at — 'a sanctuary for a little while' or 'a small sanctuary.' God Himself becomes the exiles' temple in foreign lands — divine presence is not bound to architecture.

- **11:23**: The glory departs to the mountain east of the city — traditionally identified with the Mount of Olives. The departure is complete; YHWH has vacated His house.

— EMET
